text: ポケモンと　そうぐう　しにくくなった！

structure.jp: そうぐう　しにくくなった！
structure.en: it became harder to have encounters!

patterns.name: 〜にくい
patterns.explanation: にくい added to a verb says it is hard to do. そうぐう しにくい = 'hard to encounter'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: Changing the final い to く and adding なる says something becomes that way. しにくくなった = 'became harder to do'.
